howto: The green candy hangs from numbered ropes. Swipe across a rope to cut it (or tap the rope, or press its number key).
The candy swings and falls with real momentum, so when you cut matters as much as which rope.
Land it on the wooden platform. Spikes or leaving the screen end the try.
Collect the 3 gold stars on the way for 3 stars. 8 levels, each unlocked by finishing the one before.
tips: Cut while the candy is swinging towards where you want it to go: it keeps that speed.
With two ropes, cutting one turns the other into a swing.
Undo puts the last rope back exactly where it was, so you can retry the timing.
Hint searches for a cut that still lands (and names the moment) using the game's own physics; using it caps the level at 2 stars.

controls.keyboard: 1, 2, 3 cut that rope; Space cuts the next rope; Z undoes. Arrows pick a level on the title, Space plays. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe across a rope (or tap it) to cut. Undo and Hint sit under the play field. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Levels ramp from one rope and a straight drop to three ropes with spikes; each level unlocks the next. The Hint button is the assist.

cheats.effect: The candy moves at half speed
Stars are collected from three times as far away

features.hints: Hint button under the play field (and Pause > Hint): searches the physics for a cut that still lands, highlights the rope and draws a dashed ring where the candy should be when you cut
features.undo: Undo puts the last cut rope back and rewinds the candy to that moment
features.level-select-or-daily: 8-level select on the title screen with the stars earned on each; levels unlock in order
features.results: PERFECT LANDING! card with stars; MISSED! / OUCH, SPIKES! card with Undo or retry
